description: This file defines a Perl module 'Git::SVN::Prompt' that provides authentication callback functions for integrating SVN authentication into Git. It includes functions for handling username, passwords, SSL certificate trust, and client certificates, along with detailed prompts and handling of user responses.

methods.name: simple
methods.description: Handles simple authentication by setting username and prompting for password if necessary.

methods.name: ssl_server_trust
methods.description: Handles SSL server trust validation prompts, displaying certificate info and asking user to accept or reject.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert
methods.description: Prompts for client SSL certificate file path.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert_pw
methods.description: Prompts for client SSL certificate password.

methods.name: username
methods.description: Sets username, prompting if not predefined.

methods.name: _read_password
methods.description: Reads password input from user securely.
